title: 第二百八十八章 封号之威第二百八十七章 生死一瞬
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
砰！砰！
两人重重摔落在乱石滩上，翻滚出十余丈才停下。
张三挣扎着想要爬起，但全身如同散架般剧痛，魂力几乎耗尽，脑中更是嗡鸣不止，视线模糊。
而就在他勉强撑起身子的瞬间——
一道庞大的阴影笼罩了他。
血瞳鬼蛛王那狰狞的口器，已近在咫尺！幽紫的毒牙泛着死亡的光芒，朝着张三的胸膛狠狠刺下！
这一击若中，张三必死无疑！
“张三——！！！”
朱华音的惊呼声中，一道纤瘦窈窕的身影猛然扑到张三身前！
是朱华音！
她不知从哪里爆发出最后的力量，竟拖着崴伤的右脚，硬生生挡在了张三面前！
白银玄凤笛横在她的胸前，迎着那刺下的毒牙，格挡而去！
铛——！！！
金属交击的刺耳巨响爆开！
毒牙与笛身碰撞的瞬间，白银玄凤笛上雕刻的凤纹骤然亮起璀璨的光芒，试图抵御这恐怖的一击。
然而，八万年兽王的全力一击，岂是魂力耗尽、武魂真身后处于虚弱期的朱华音所能抵挡？
“咔嚓——！”
一声清晰的碎裂声响起。
白银玄凤笛的笛身上，出现了一道细密的裂纹。
紧接着，裂纹如同蛛网般迅速蔓延，瞬间布满了整个笛身！

“噗——！”朱华音喷出一口鲜血，整个人如同被巨锤击中，倒飞出去，重重摔在张三身旁。
而她手中的白银玄凤笛，也在这一刻——
砰然断裂！
化作无数银白色的光点，消散在空气中。
武魂……碎了。
对于魂师而言，武魂破碎几乎是仅次于死亡的重创。
魂力溃散，修为大跌，甚至可能永远无法再唤出武魂。
朱华音躺在地上，面纱早已脱落，露出那张惨白如纸却依旧绝美的容颜，她看着手中消散的光点，眼中闪过一丝茫然，随即化为释然。
至少……张三还活着……
她艰难地转过头，看向一旁挣扎着爬起的张三，嘴唇动了动，似乎想说什么，却只涌出一口鲜血。
“朱前辈——！！！”
张三目眦欲裂，扑到朱华音身边，将她抱在怀中。他能感觉到，朱华音的气息正在迅速衰弱，生命如同风中残烛，随时可能熄灭。
content_en:
Bang! Bang!
The two fell heavily onto the rocky beach and rolled for more than ten feet before stopping.
Zhang San struggled to get up, but his whole body was in severe pain as if falling apart, his soul power was almost exhausted, his head was buzzing, and his vision was blurred.
And the moment he managed to hold himself up——
A huge shadow enveloped him.
The ferocious mouthparts of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King are very close at hand! Youzi's poisonous fangs glowed with the light of death, and stabbed hard at Zhang San's chest!
If this blow hits, Zhang San will definitely die!
"Zhang San——!!!"
Amidst Zhu Huayin's exclamations, a slender figure suddenly rushed in front of Zhang San!
It's Zhu Huayin!
She burst out her final strength from nowhere, dragging her injured right foot and blocking Zhang San forcefully!
The silver black phoenix flute lay across her chest, blocking the piercing fangs!
clang--! ! !
The harsh and loud sound of metal clashing exploded!
The moment the fangs collided with the flute body, the phoenix pattern carved on the silver black phoenix flute suddenly lit up brightly, trying to resist this terrifying blow.
However, how could Zhu Huayin, who had exhausted her soul power and was in a weak stage after her martial soul transformation, withstand the full blow of the 80,000-year-old Beast King?
"Crack——!"
A clear cracking sound sounded.
A fine crack appeared on the body of the Silver Black Phoenix Flute.
Immediately afterwards, the cracks spread quickly like a spider web, covering the entire flute body in an instant!
"Pfft——!" Zhu Huayin spurted out a mouthful of blood, and his whole body felt as if he had been hit by a giant hammer. He flew backwards and fell heavily next to Zhang San.
And the silver Xuanfeng flute in her hand was also at this moment——
Break with a bang!
It turned into countless silver-white light spots and dissipated in the air.
The martial spirit... was broken.
For a soul master, having his martial soul shattered is almost a serious injury second only to death.
The soul power is dissipated, the cultivation level plummets, and it may even be impossible to summon the martial soul again.
Zhu Huayin was lying on the ground, her veil had long since fallen off, revealing her face as pale as paper but still beautiful. She looked at the dissipated light spots in her hands, and a trace of confusion flashed in her eyes, which then turned into relief.
At least... Zhang San is still alive...
She turned her head with difficulty and looked at Zhang San who was struggling to get up. Her lips moved as if she wanted to say something, but only a mouthful of blood came out.
"Senior Zhu——!!!"
Zhang San's eyes were about to burst, he rushed to Zhu Huayin and held her in his arms. He could feel that Zhu Huayin's breath was rapidly weakening, and his life was like a candle in the wind, which might be extinguished at any time.
